enable.description: Whether Geoclue is enabled. Disable to prevent any location services.

network_provider.description: Enable network-based geolocation (Wi-Fi/cell towers/IP). May expose network data.

gps_provider.description: Enable GPS hardware support. Requires physical GPS device and permissions.

geoip_provider.description: Enable IP-based geolocation fallback. Less accurate but widely supported.

time_server.description: NTP server hostname or IP. Accurate system time is required for some location methods.

min_time_between_updates.description: Minimum seconds between location updates. Lower values increase responsiveness but battery usage.

min_distance_between_updates.description: Minimum meters of movement required to trigger an update. Higher values save power.

max_cache_age.description: Maximum age (seconds) of cached location fixes. Stale data is discarded beyond this.

allowed_apps.description: List of allowed application executables (basenames only) that may request location. Empty = all allowed.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0=error, 1=warning, 2=info, 3=debug. Use higher levels for troubleshooting.

log_domains.description: Comma-separated list of log domains (e.g., 'all', 'gpsd', 'network', 'geoip'). Controls which subsystems are logged.

log_destination.description: Log output target: 'systemd' for journald, or a file path (e.g., '/var/log/geoclue.log').

log_uptime_format.description: Timestamp format for logs: 'iso8601' (e.g., '2023-12-01T10:30:00Z') or 'uptime' (seconds since boot).
